sections.heading: Winning
items: Be the first player to get rid of all your cards

sections.heading: Players & Deck
items: 108-card deck: 4 colours (red, yellow, green, blue), each with one 0, two each of 1–9, two Skip, two Reverse, two Draw Two; plus 4 Wild and 4 Wild Draw Four

sections.heading: Action Cards
items: Reverse — reverse direction. In a 2-player game, acts as a Skip
Skip — next player loses their turn
Wild — change the colour of play; may be played on any turn even if you have other playable cards
Wild Draw Four — change colour AND next player draws 4

sections.heading: Dealing
items: Each player draws a card; highest deals (action cards count as 0). Or just pick a dealer randomly
Dealer shuffles and deals 7 cards each
Remaining cards form the Draw Pile; flip the top card to start the Discard Pile

First-card specials — Wild: dealer chooses colour. Wild Draw Four: return to deck and pick another. Draw Two: first player draws 2 and skips. Reverse: play starts with dealer. Skip: first player loses turn. Or you could also ignore all special cards until and discard a normal card
Who goes first is configurable in the rule library

sections.heading: How to play a card
items: On your turn, play one card matching the top discard by colour, number, or symbol — or play a Wild

sections.heading: Calling "UNO"
items: When you play your second-to-last card, yell "UNO!". The penalty for forgetting is configurable in the rule library

sections.heading: Scoring
items: How you win is configurable in the rule library

When using points scoring, the winner of each hand scores all opponents' remaining cards (number cards are worth their face value; Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20 each; Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 each); first to 500 points wins
When using wins-based scoring, just count rounds won
